description: Machine-readable task-type policies. Loaded by orchestration gatekeeper based on task classification.

successCriteria.files_changed_on_disk: FIRST — the code change exists on disk and can be proven with ls/wc -l/git diff --cached
successCriteria.validation_command_executed: SECOND — the repo's canonical validation command was invoked
successCriteria.validation_result_captured: THIRD — the stdout/exit code of validation was observed and recorded
successCriteria.commit_hash_on_success: FOURTH — on pass only, a commit was made with the changes and validation passed

failureBehavior.onValidationFail: STOP. Record exact failing stage. Do NOT create commit. Do NOT claim completion.
failureBehavior.errorMessage: Validation failed at <stage>. Root cause: <message>. Fix before retrying.

write_doc.classificationHint: Writing or updating documentation (.md files, README, ARCHITECTURE, AGENTS)

successCriteria.commit_hash_on_success: SECOND — on pass, a commit was made

failureBehavior.onConflict: STOP. Record which file has markers.
failureBehavior.errorMessage: Conflict marker found in <file>. Fix before committing.

refactor.classificationHint: Structural code reorganization without behavior change

successCriteria.no_regression_confirmed: FOURTH — no behavioral regression proven (test pass, compile pass, or manual verification of unchanged output)
successCriteria.commit_hash_on_success: FIFTH — on pass only, commit made

failureBehavior.onValidationFail: STOP. Record exact failing stage. Do NOT commit. Regression risk must be addressed.
failureBehavior.errorMessage: Refactor validation failed at <stage>. Root cause: <message>. No behavioral changes allowed — revert or fix before retrying.

audit.classificationHint: Reviewing, inspecting, or analyzing code without making changes (read-only)

successCriteria.findings_documented: Findings recorded in report format with file evidence

failureBehavior.onUnintendedWrite: STOP. Audit tasks must not write code.
failureBehavior.errorMessage: Audit task attempted to modify files. Only read operations allowed.
